title: Does private preschool really give children a head start?
summary: In rural India, children in private preschools learn far more than those in public ones. Unequal access to private preschools explains most of the learning gap between richer and poorer children at school entry.

title: Can a one-hour documentary change long-term economic behaviour?
summary: A randomised trial in rural Ethiopia found that a single one-hour screening of documentaries featuring relatable role models produced lasting increases in farm investment, schooling, and household wealth five years on.

title: Can bank access help farmers weather climate shocks?
summary: India's 1980s rural bank branch expansion only had modest effects on average agricultural output, but it substantially reduced farmers' vulnerability to adverse rainfall shocks, largely by helping them sustain irrigation.

title: The birth of Bangladesh: How the Bhola cyclone fostered revolution
